# Descriptions
@@ 1
Creates a black, insubstantial wall up to 20' x 20' x 1'' that light cannot
pass into or through (i.e., it does not hinder movement, but it blocks
vision).
@@ 2
Creates a wall of dense churning air up to 10' x 10' x 3'. This wall reduces
all movement through it by 50%. In addition, all attacks through the wall
suffer a -50 penalty.
@@ 3
As Light Wall I, except for duration.
@@ 4
Creates a wall of water up to 10' x 10' x 1'. This wall reduces all movement
through it by 80%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -80
penalty.
@@ 5
Creates a wall of wood up to 10' x 20' x 2''. This wall can be burned though,
chopped through, or toppled (if not propped up somehow).
@@ 7
As Woodwall, except wall is made of earth and has a size up to 10' x 10' x (3'
at base, 1' at top) of packed earth.
@@ 8
As Woodwall, except wall is made of ice and has a size up to 10' x 10' x (2'
at base, 1' at top). It can be melted, chipped through, or toppled (if not
propped up somehow).
@@ 10
Opens a pit (500 cubic feet in stone; 1000 cubic feet in earth or ice). The
entire pit must be within 50' of caster. A pit may not be opened except on a
horizontal surface with an incline of less than 45º.
@@ 11
As Airwall, except for duration.
@@ 12
As Woodwall, except wall is made of stone and has a size up to 10' x 10' x 1'.
It can be chipped through.
@@ 13
As Waterwall, except for duration.
@@ 15
As Woodwall, except for duration.
@@ 17
As Earth Wall, except for duration.
@@ 18
As Icewall I, except wall is up to 20' x 20' x (4' at base, 2' at top).
@@ 20
As Stonewall, except for duration.
@@ 25
Fuses 2 touching walls (seam can be up to 20' long) or fuses a section of
stone blocks (up to 100 cubic feet’).
@@ 30
As any one of the lower level “wall” spells on this list, except the wall can
be curved up to a semicircle.
@@ 50
By directly Channeling the power of his deity, the caster creates a
transparent wall of “force” that is absolutely impassable by anyone or
anything. It can be up to 10' x 20' x 1''.
